name: com.delta.unity-mcp
description: In-editor AI assistant + MCP bridge for Unity. Create/inspect scene objects, prefabs, materials and terrain from chat; run perf audits (FPS/GC/draw calls/GPU instancing), read console/exceptions/logs, audit textures, and scan code for refactors. Works standalone in any Unity 6 project. Network (Fusion) features degrade gracefully when Fusion is absent.
